content:
The task was successfully completed by using openpyxl to programmatically inject INDEX/MATCH and statistical formulas into the Excel workbook.
Absolute references like Data!$A$21:$A$38 and mixed references for lookups ($D12, H$10) ensured formula stability across the grid. Statistical functions (MIN, MAX, MEDIAN, AVERAGE, PERCENTILE) were mapped to rows 42-47 based on label verification. The weighted mean in row 50 was correctly implemented using a SUMPRODUCT/SUM pattern referencing calculated buffers and capacity weights.
